# Off-GPU inventory

**GPU 100% target: every site below ticked off, nothing off the GPU.**

Generated by `node scripts/off-gpu-scan.mjs --doc` (`npm run offgpu`); do not edit by hand. The checklist at the end is regenerated from the scan, so a site leaves it when it moves to the GPU.
No percentage blocks a push or a deploy; the honest score is printed and the target is 100%. What each category means is at the top of the script.

**842/6081 on GPU (13% honest, counting 1227 class-write and timer/observer sites; target 100%), 5239 off: frame path 3251, during use 1980, no caller found 8; 310 setup sites left out of the count and listed; 1956 tagged run-once/rare allocations (// alloc-rare: reason) also left out, listed with their reasons; per-frame view (event-only sites set aside): 842/4101 on GPU (20%), 1980 event-only sites listed apart (timer or rest pass 549, event or timer 425, stored callback 301, event handler 284, observer 159, store or registry listener 138, promise 54, a method of this name is called from stored callback 25, a method of this name is called from timer or rest pass 24, motion handler 11, a method of this name is called from event handler 7, a method of this name is called from store or registry listener 3)**.

**Warm garbage: 128743 B/frame over 10 frame functions** (compiled, in node; `npm run warm`), over their limit or failed: pressure-time ingest (real engine frames). stage frame with the vessels (stage.js + veins-gl.js, 60 Hz display, 30 Hz model) 64458 B; pressure-time chart drawn by the GPU pen (pressure-time.js + trace-gl.js, update and redraw) 17786 B; display-state: colour follows, scalar follows and the shown state, a frame of each 1022 B; label-gl: reading 30 labels (describeBlock, svgOnly, lookKey), as a sync reads those that changed 36934 B; glass-gl: the blur plan of eight glasses (blurBoxesInto), a picture 2 B; blood.advanceStream, 40 streams 2290 B; pressure-time ingest (real engine frames) 6245 B; flow-rows changedRows + retireRows + flowClose 2 B; uniform-cache, a frame of fifty uniforms 2 B; veins-bin splitCells into a kept record 2 B.
